title: Reduce progress stale flicker
summary: Reduced false progress stale flicker during publish copy by widening backend freshness for publish-copy telemetry and adding Home run-progress stale display hysteresis.
reason: Robocopy publish-copy telemetry can pause longer than the default 5-second progress heartbeat without indicating a real stall. The operator UI should avoid flashing stale/review for one harmless stale sample while preserving quick stale detection for encode/remux/scan and raw diagnostics.
behavior_before: All active pipeline stages used a 5-second LastUpdate-only stale check, and the Home run-progress timeline rendered every backend stale flag immediately.
behavior_after: Publish-copy progress uses a 30-second stale window and considers the freshest parseable LastUpdate or CopyUpdatedAt timestamp. Non-publish active stages keep the 5-second stale rule. The Home run-progress timeline shows stale/review only after two consecutive stale snapshots for the same active item and clears pending confirmation on fresh snapshots or item changes; Diagnostics and backend DTOs remain raw.
